summary: Ridgetech Inc. filed a Form 6-K furnishing its earnings release for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026. The release details financial results: revenue of $132.16 million (+10.2% YoY), gross profit of $4.75 million, and a net loss of $1.25 million versus prior-year net income. Management commentary references prior acquisitions and divestitures, but this filing itself is a routine periodic earnings announcement, not a special-situation transaction. No new deal terms, premium, or transaction structure are disclosed. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer earnings report with no actionable special-situations angle.
